Team — after reviewing the numbers and the waterfall attachment, I can provide conditional executive approval with the following controls: 

1) Commercial guardrails (required):
   - Accept the proposed waterfall subject to a minimum blended Redwood take of 55% in year 1 (effective across the first 12 months).
   - The total concession (present value of any discount/revenue share lift) must not exceed $40k for the first 12 months.
2) Term & payment:
   - 24-month term is acceptable. However, Finance prefers Net30; we will allow Net45 only if CloudBridge signs an early-pay credit instrument (we will draft) that grants Redwood the right to invoice early in the event of non-payment.
   - Upfront 50% payment can be accepted as a prepayment credit; Finance (Lauren) to confirm booking approach.
3) Legal redlines (Markus):
   - No broad indemnities for listing activities. We require a standard limitation of liability and standard data-processing addendum. Markus, if legal can clear on those points and confirm the listing language is standard, we are good to proceed.
4) Marketplace listing & ops:
   - Ops will require an SOW for implementation and a 90-day go-live SLA attached to the private listing.

If legal and finance confirm they can work within these guardrails, this counts as exec clearance and Jonas can send a counter that incorporates the waterfall table with the blended minimum and the concession cap.

Lauren — please confirm Net45 exceptions and whether the early-pay credit instrument is viable. Markus — please return redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
